title: Seed Biology, Germination & Seedling Establishment
level: Propagation & Clean Stock Specialist / advanced specialization development
intendedAudience: Learners entering the Propagation & Clean Stock Specialist pathway
Cultivation personnel responsible for seed-lot intake, germination, seedling establishment, propagation records and early-stage quality control
prerequisites: Cultivation Technician I propagation competency or approved equivalent prerequisite evidence before specialist certification activation
evidencePolicy: Cannabis/hemp-specific research supports seed biology, germination and temperature-response concepts. Experimental treatment values and cultivar-specific results are evidence, not universal facility setpoints. General horticultural propagation guidance may support media and sanitation concepts when clearly identified as non-cannabis-specific.
assessmentPolicy: The dedicated specialist final is development-only until exact-version technical/assessment review, accessibility review and pilot evidence are complete. Completion does not authorize unapproved chemical treatments, disease-control actions or facility protocol changes.
description: Builds specialist capability in seed identity, provenance, reproductive origin, viability and vigor, evidence-based germination, seedling establishment, sanitation, traceability, batch QA and troubleshooting.
learningOutcomes: Analyze seed identity, lot provenance, reproductive origin and basic seed anatomy before selecting or documenting a germination workflow.
Differentiate viability, vigor, germination percentage, germination rate and seedling establishment so propagation records do not treat these as interchangeable outcomes.
Evaluate germination conditions using cannabis/hemp evidence while separating research-treatment values from facility-specific operating targets.
Assess seedling establishment using root-zone moisture, aeration, media condition, sanitation and developmental evidence rather than a single visual symptom.
Create a reconstructable seed-to-seedling batch record that preserves identity, denominator, timing, abnormal outcomes, interventions, uncertainty and escalation.
